title: Drafting Preferences
description: Durable drafting defaults for replies, handoffs, escalations, and documentation reviews.

empathy_level.description: Standing empathy level for customer-facing or customer-adjacent drafts.

brevity_preference.description: Preferred verbosity level for repeated drafts.

documentation_style.description: Preferred tone for documentation-worthiness reviews and documentation-adjacent outputs.

avoid_long_apologies.description: Whether replies should avoid extended apology language by default.

include_recommended_next_step.description: Whether repeated drafts should usually include an explicit next step.
